name: Jiangxi Huangshanghuang Group Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Huangshanghuang Group Food Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, processing, and sales of braised and marinated products, rice products, and freeze-dried food products in China and internationally. It operates through Jiangxi, Guangdong, Slaughter Business, Fujian, Liaoning, Shaanxi, Chongqing, Zhejiang, Rice Products Business, Freeze-Drying Business, and Other segments. The company offers hand-shredded braised duck, braised duck, and signature braised duck wings; pipa sauce duck, braised beef, braised beef tripe, braised tofu skin, braised pork intestines, and cold beef salad; braised duck neck, ribs, intestines, feet, neck, ton…
